entities.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics
entities.summary: Page views reported by Cloudflare's beacon, which Cloudflare injects into the page.
entities.meaning: Visits to the game's page and to the scores page.
excludes: Anything inside the game: reigns, keys, scores and names are not reported.
entities.details: Both pages' content security policies allow the beacon's script and its reports; nothing in this folder emits them. The page also loads the games hub's /games/play.js with data-game="samosa"; what that script records is the hub's. The Worker writes no logs or metrics of its own: an unexpected error becomes a 500 with { error: "server error" } and is not recorded.
